title: ATEP delegation
description: Section 7.1. A signed credential from a principal's platform stating what the caller may do for that principal. $defs/credential_payload is the Verifiable Credential payload of the credential field; $defs/healthcare_authorization is the Section 9 extension.

credential.description: Section 7.1. A JWS over the delegation body signed by the platform's key; its payload is $defs/credential_payload.

revocation_response.description: Section 7.1. The body of GET revocation_url.

healthcare_authorization.description: Section 9. healthcare_authorization: { statement, authorized_at } - a statement, signed by the platform, that the principal authorized this platform to schedule on their behalf, and the RFC 3339 date of that authorization.

credential_payload.description: Section 7.1. The payload of the credential JWS, shaped as a W3C Verifiable Credential.

issuer.description: Section 7.1. The platform that signed the credential.

credentialSubject.description: Section 7.1. credentialSubject is the delegation body without credential. Section 9 adds healthcare_authorization.

credential_payload_healthcare.description: Section 9. The credential payload for a session with a healthcare answerer: credentialSubject.healthcare_authorization is REQUIRED.

body.description: Section 7.1. The delegation body: every field except the credential that signs it. This is the shape of credentialSubject.

id.description: Section 7.1. Opaque and stable for the principal on that platform.

name.description: Section 7.1. A display name; it need not be a legal name.

contact.description: Section 7.1. The number the business may use for this booking.

platform.description: Section 7.1. The platform card the credential is verified against.

scope.description: Section 7.1. The intents this delegation covers.

caps.description: Section 7.1. Bounds on the scoped intents.

identity_verification.description: Section 7.1. Fixed at "none" in v1. The caller MUST NOT answer security questions or supply identity documents, dates of birth, account numbers, or one-time codes.

expires.description: Section 7.1. No more than 24 hours after issued.

x-atep-max-lifetime.description: Section 7.1. expires MUST be no more than 24 hours after issued.
